# Mercury 2

Mercury 2 is a reasoning diffusion language model (dLLM). It combines parallel token refinement with tunable reasoning depth. See live metrics on this page for current throughput.

- **Model ID:** `inception/mercury-2`
- **Type:** chat
- **Providers:** inception
- **Context window:** 128,000
- **Maximum output tokens:** 128,000
- **Pricing:** $0.25/1M input tokens, $0.75/1M output tokens
- **Canonical page:** https://vercel.com/ai-gateway/models/mercury-2
